#### 1. achondrogenesis type II  —  Tier 1 — Definitive / Highly Plausible  (fitness 0.789)
**Link type:** shared pathway (Reactome:R-HSA-186797, Reactome:R-HSA-198933, Reactome:R-HSA-2022090, Reactome:R-HSA-216083, Reactome:R-HSA-3000171)

**Proposed mechanism:** COL2A1 (HGNC:2200) —DISRUPTS→ Type II collagen synthesis and extracellular matrix organization (GO:0030198); Type II collagen synthesis and extracellular matrix organization (GO:0030198) —LEADS_TO→ Skeletal dysplasia (HP:0008908); Type II collagen synthesis and extracellular matrix organization (GO:0030198) —LEADS_TO→ Dwarfism (HP:0000005). Mutations in COL2A1 disrupt the synthesis and organization of type II collagen, a critical component of the extracellular matrix in cartilage and bone. This disruption leads to the skeletal dysplasias characteristic of spondyloperipheral dysplasia and the severe dwarfism seen in achondrogenesis type II.

**How to falsify it:** Discovery of pathogenic variants in COL2A1 with divergent functional consequences (e.g., a loss-of-function variant causing one disease and a gain-of-function variant causing the other) or the identification of a distinct causal gene for one of the diseases that does not interact with the type II collagen pathway. _(variant: rs121918004)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared role of COL2A1 in these distinct skeletal dysplasias could lead to therapeutic strategies targeting collagen synthesis or extracellular matrix integrity, potentially benefiting patients with either condition.
